name: 太平清醮節慶元宇宙：虛擬實境市集 × 博物館
summary:
The Cheung Chau Tai Ping Qing Jiao Festival originated in the 19th century, when the island’s residents held religious ceremonies to pray to the deities to soothe the souls of the deceased and ward off disasters and misfortunes in order to drive away epidemics. This tradition has continued to the present day, evolving into an annual, large-scale community event lasting five days and four nights
that aims to pray for peace and prosperity. In 2011, it was inscribed on the National List of Intangible Cultural
